Container.Name: kisscut
Container.Overview: Turn logos and images into smooth, layered SVGs for Cricut vinyl. Save a project to a link anyone can open to pick up where it was left off.

Config.Name: Projects
Config.Description: Saved projects: each one's image and settings.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Base address used in share links and link previews, e.g. https://kisscut.example.com. Leave empty to use the address in the browser.

Config.Name: Behind a reverse proxy
Config.Description: true when served through Nginx Proxy Manager or another proxy, so rate limits see real client addresses.

Config.Name: Delete unused projects after (days)
Config.Description: 0 keeps projects forever. Otherwise a project nobody has opened or saved for this many days is deleted.

Config.Name: Storage cap (MB)
Config.Description: 0 = no cap. Past this, new projects are refused (updates still work).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the saved files.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the saved files.
